item.title: Only 8.9% of sites block AI crawlers, but 94.8% are never cited in AI answers
Best way to avoid bloat and AI – selfcontaining OS
item.description:
I wanted an OS that I could truly own. Most modern systems have become server-controlled clients, bloated with dependencies (Gtk4/Qt/Rust/Wayland) and centralized source control on GitHub. If you cannot audit the dependency tree and Big Corp controls the source, it is no longer real open source.

I built OneManBSD to address this. It is an OpenBSD-based system built on a single 2012 ThinkPad L430.

Project Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2wHaoQhXOYY Project Page: https://bialamusic.com/onemanBSD/

item.title: Europeans Are About to Find Out How Entrenched AI Is in Their Daily Lives
Damned if you do and damned if you don't: Can NOT using AI amount to negligence?
Show HN: Documan – AI Powered Requirement Management Workspace
item.description:
That is a tool that I have developed based on my own needs since it was a shame not to use AI for requirement generation. There are ancient tools like IBM DOORS but they require buying seat licences and they don't have any support for LLMs. I see that requirement management is a mess most of time, people are going back and forth between tools and Excel and Word. Customer couldn't track requirement history and don't be able to oversee which documents needs to be changed for specific system requirement. For these reasons, I built DocuMan. It follows military and industry standarts for document descriptions. You can import your customer specs and generate all documents for your hardware and software configuration items. Just give it your system breakdown, it will handle rest. There are lots of features I need to implement but it became very usefull with its current state so I would like to share it with the world. Please let me know what you think.
